awards: Best Film — Baden-Württemberg Youth Film Award 2019
projects.title: Abszission
projects.synopsis:
Abszission is a 20-minute short film by Jeanine Lang, which won Best Film at the 2019 Baden-Württemberg Youth Film Award.

I had the opportunity to compose the soundtrack, which primarily features atmospheric synthesizers and gentle piano melodies. Additionally, in collaboration with Annika Landgraf, we created the credits song "In the Club."

projects.title: Au milieu de l’été
projects.synopsis: „Au milieu de l’été“ was written and produced for the Filmakademie BW, ARTE & SWR Co-Production „Let’s call it love“ by producers Sophie Ataya, Oumayma Zekri Ajarrai and Director Sejad Ademaj.

projects.title: Dough with a hole
projects.synopsis: „Oh, there’s a hole in that dough“ is the official Game Soundtrack for Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg Diploma „Dough with a hole“ directed by Rike Ziegler. This cozy game is all about baking donuts! Of course some relaxing uplifting Bossa Nova music shouldn’t be missing, so here we are!

projects.title: Kinnhakenhank
projects.synopsis:
Aquaman, Ant-Man, Batman… The list of superhero movies that have dominated the big screen in recent years, thanks to Marvel, DC, and others, seems endless – just like the profits production companies have been able to rake in.

One thing is clear: Germany finally needs its own superhero!

Kinnhakenhank is here to save German cinema from the domination of films by Schweiger and Schweighöfer! However, it’s probably clear from the name that he is not your typical blockbuster superhero. In fact, it’s not Kinnhakenhank, but 11-year-old Piet, who is the real hero of this story. A completely ordinary boy – without magical powers, without excessive muscle mass, and without divine heritage.

And therein lies the charm of the film: It doesn’t tell the story of a superhero learning how to fight, but of an average boy who grows beyond himself through good deeds.

At first, Piet looks up to Kinnhakenhank as his big idol. But over the course of the film, he realizes that his own mother, Martha, is the true role model. Through her empathetic, thoughtful, and brave actions, she inspires Piet to become a better person – one who considers others and thinks with his head rather than his fists.

The short film intentionally contrasts with traditional superhero blockbusters, where women often need to be saved by their heroes. While Kinnhakenhank may not be the next big Spider-Man or Captain America of the superhero world, it is definitely a story with heart – especially because of the protagonist with whom everyone can identify.

Best Actress — Jeanine Lang, Baden-Württemberg Youth Film Award 2020
projects.title: Karussell
projects.synopsis:
Karussell is a short film project created in collaboration with Jeanine Lang (acting & screenplay) and Joanna Lutz (production & set assistance).

This project was spontaneous yet deeply personal, as it explores a feeling we all experience - the sense that life is rushing past us, and we’re struggling to keep up.

The film was nominated in four categories at the 2020 Baden-Württemberg Youth Film Award and earned Jeanine Lang the award for Best Acting Performance.

projects.title: Leaving Earth
projects.synopsis:
"Leaving Earth" is one of my own songs, produced in collaboration with Walter Schimon and released on all music streaming services.

With all the problems currently affecting the world (COVID-19, wars, climate change, etc.), it might sometimes seem easier to just hop into a spaceship and fly away. But of course, it's not that simple. And looking away certainly won't solve these issues.

That’s why the message of the video is: "Make a change!"

projects.title: Lilly’s Lullaby
projects.synopsis: Lilly’s Lullaby is a four and a half minute long composition for medium-sized orchestra. It was recorded in September 2025 in Bratislava with the Symphonica Recording Orchestra Bratislava conducted by Sebastian Greim.

projects.title: Sternenmeer
projects.synopsis: This project was created within five days as part of the Visual Music Workshop at the Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg. To achieve a unique soundscape all samples were recorded by ourselves.

credits.name: Sebastian Greim & Leon Maximilian Brückner, Samples unterm Sofa

projects.title: Give It Up for You
projects.synopsis:
My second single, "Give It Up for You," is available on all streaming platforms!

Huge thanks to Walter Schimon for his support with mixing and mastering, and to Madlen Medvedovskyy for the amazing cover design!

projects.title: Silver Strings
projects.synopsis:
As if life in old age weren’t challenging enough, daughter Anna also can’t stop nagging her father. But one day he discovers a spider in his house — and suddenly everything becomes easier.

This beautifully animated short film by Paul Kley explores a complicated father–daughter relationship and the growing challenges that arise as parents get older.

projects.title: Rollen am Klavier
projects.synopsis: Triggered by the end of her first relationship, Yuna's memory flushes an image from her early childhood to the surface, but she cannot place it. In search of a connection, she explores the depths of her subconscious. She keeps coming across blank spots until she finally manages to get to the source of the suppressed memory.

projects.title: Entering Wonderland
projects.synopsis: During my studies at Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg I was given the great opportunity to record with the Babelsberger Filmmusikorchester. The final edit and master will be available soon!

site.title: Pianissimo Production
site.description: Film music and directing by Sebastian Greim. Two perspectives. One storyteller.
biography: I’m Sebastian Greim, a composer and filmmaker working at the meeting point of music and moving images. Since 2020, I’ve collaborated with filmmakers and businesses on film scores, songs and video productions.
For me, music and film are all about rhythm. My background in Media Engineering and studies in Film Music at Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg inform a personal approach to every story.
